nodes.text:
Mind the rail, it's more suggestion than rail.

I keep the deck. Not the inn - the DECK. Forty feet of ship that is not allowed to rot yet.

It holds because I am extremely annoying about it.

Every board that goes soft, I pull. Ilse thinks I am obsessive. Ilse has never been on a deck that gave way.

Quiet. Too quiet, and then not quiet at all, and you learn which one you are in by whether the chanting has a rhythm to it.

Ain counts it. I have asked him to stop telling me the number.
